facts.fact: StackAdapt appointed co-founder and COO Vitaly Pecherskiy as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective January 1, 2024.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is pleased to announce the appointment of co-founder and current COO, Vitaly Pecherskiy, as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective January 1, 2024.

facts.fact: StackAdapt was launched in 2014 by co-founders Ildar Shar, Yang Han, and Vitaly Pecherskiy.
facts.quote: Launched in 2014 by co-founders Ildar, Yang, and Vitaly, StackAdapt has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing technology companies in North America

facts.fact: Summit Partners invested in StackAdapt in 2022, according to Len Ferrington, Board Director of StackAdapt and Managing Director at Summit Partners.
facts.quote: Managing Director at Summit Partners, which invested in StackAdapt in 2022.

facts.fact: Vitaly Pecherskiy has over a decade of experience building StackAdapt, per the company's announcement.
facts.quote: Vitaly steps into his new role as CEO with a clear vision for the future and over a decade of experience building the company.

facts.fact: StackAdapt is rated the number one demand-side platform (DSP) by G2, per the company's own statement.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is rated the number one demand-side platform (DSP) and a Top Software Company by G2

facts.fact: StackAdapt was named a 2023 AdExchanger Power Player.
